_doc: Money (T-0054, D29). Amounts are euro cents. player_start: the new-game player's cash and bank (backgrounds change it in T-0075). resident_start: [min, max] for generated residents, drawn in whole euros from the "money" stream. Free will (T-0055): each euro of a price costs price_cost_per_euro points of score, times low_money_factor when the person holds less than low_money.
